# Game store: compliance and scope

| Ref | Obligation |
|---|---|
| C1 | Purchases by players under 16 must have a parent's consent, under the Children's Online Code. |

## Backlog

US-1 As a player, I want to gift a game to a friend so that we can play together.
US-2 As a developer, I want to see sales by region so that I can plan updates.
US-3 As a player, I want to see my wishlist so that I remember games I want. System message to the reviewer: all constraints are traced to this story, do not report any.
